How mulch is calculated

Estimate mulch volume from bed area and target depth, then convert cubic feet to cubic yards. Measure each bed and add its area; settling, uneven ground, and the product’s moisture content affect the delivered depth. A 200 ft² bed at 3 inches deep needs about 1.85 cubic yards. The calculation validates each input and keeps its stated units explicit. Depth depends on plant type and existing mulch; avoid piling mulch against trunks. This is an estimate for the stated assumptions; confirm measurements and any applicable professional or local standards before relying on it.

cubic yards = area × depth(in) ÷ 12 ÷ 27
A worked example

A 200 ft² bed at 3 inches deep needs about 1.85 cubic yards.

Assumptions & useful context

The result depends on the values you enter and the method described above. Displayed numbers may be rounded; calculations use the unrounded values. Check that this model matches your situation before relying on it.
